clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's anxiety rose as she lay awake over money in March 1988, then in May 1988 she and your father stopped talking about money; your grandfather died in July 1989; your brother Felix's grades fell by November 1989; your mother's anxiety settled as she returned to work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across these nineteen months around the death, with your mother's earlier worry about money and distance from your father nearby, and only these people's shifts show in these months.
